info.description: Serves 2 | A comforting duo of eggless walnut brownies for Grandparents’ Day. Dense, indulgent and nutty, they make a sweet surprise to gift or enjoy together.

info.name: Ganesh Chaturthi Truffle Poster Cake (500gm)
info.description: Serves 6 | Welcome Bappa home with this eggless truffle poster cake and celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi with devotion and delight. Crafted for gifting, festive joy, and family celebrations. Every slice spreads blessings and togetherness.

info.name: Ganesh Chaturthi Chocolate Poster Jar Cake Duo (180ml each)
info.description: Serves 2 | Mark Ganesh Chaturthi with these eggless chocolate poster Jar Cakes, beautifully topped with festive poster designs. Ideal for gifting, they combine the warmth of tradition with the joy of indulgence, spreading divine blessings and happiness among loved ones.

info.name: Ganesh Chaturthi Walnut Brownies - Set of 2
info.description: Serves 2 | This Ganesh Chaturthi, indulge in nutty goodness with these eggless walnut brownie duo. Ideal for personal indulgence, gifting, or sharing with family, they carry the spirit of devotion and joy, making celebrations memorable with every bite.

info.name: Choco Truffle Cake

info.name: Chocolate Snicker Cake

info.description: Serves 6 | A rich blend of gooey chocolate and crunchy butterscotch nougat, this cake brings bold textures and a caramel-chocolate twist in every bite. Perfect for indulgent cravings.

info.name: Choco Chip Cake
info.description: Serves 6 | Chocolatey to the core, this cake is topped with whipped creamy dollops and hugged by crunchy choco chips on all sides. It’s rich, textured, and ready to steal the dessert spotlight.

info.name: Choco Oreo Cake

info.name: Eggless Milk Chocolate Bento Cake (300gm)
info.description: Serves 4 | Soft, spongy, and coated in silky milk chocolate, this eggless bento cake is perfect for birthdays, celebrations, or a sweet little treat-yourself moment.

info.name: Strawberry Milk Chocolate Bento Cake (300gms)
info.description: Serves 4 | This eggless milk chocolate strawberry bento cake brings sweet-tangy strawberry bits, and a soft melt-in-mouth base together for a perfectly rich taste. A sweet little box made for small celebrations, quick surprises, and moments that deserve a touch of delight.

info.name: Mango Passion Fruit Bento Cake (300gm)
info.description: Serves 4 | This eggless delight bursts with tropical flavour featuring velvety mango ganache, zesty passionfruit cream, and fruit jelly layered between soft vanilla sponge. Finished with a chocolate accent and a white chocolate disc on top.

info.name: Heart-Shaped Dark Choco Berry Bento Cake
info.description: Serves 4 | This eggless dark chocolate bento cake is layered with smooth chocolate cream, rich milk truffle, and strawberry filling. Finished with glossy truffle glaze and raspberry chocolate garnish, it’s a delightful mini treat for any sweet craving.

info.name: Pineapple Cake
info.description: Serves 6 | Light, fluffy, and refreshingly sweet — this eggless pineapple cake is layered with whipped cream and juicy pineapple chunks, then finished with almond flakes on the sides. It’s the perfect blend of sweet, fresh, and slightly nutty — a tropical treat for every celebration.

info.name: Naked Blueberry Cake
info.description: Serves 1 | Soft sponge, creamy frosting, and fresh blueberry compote come together in this eggless naked cake. A light hint of lemon adds a fresh, citrusy note that balances the fruity sweetness beautifully.

info.name: Fresh Fruit Cake

info.name: Nutella Cheesecake (600 gm)

info.name: Blueberry Cheesecake Jar

info.name: Biscoff Baked Cheesecake Slice

info.name: Strawberry Baked Cheesecake Slice

info.description: Serves 10 | The irresistible flavour of Biscoff combined with creamy cheesecake makes this eggless dessert box a party favourite. Rich, indulgent, and perfect for sharing, it’s a dessert that will steal the show at any celebration.

The creamy, tangy cheesecake topped with fresh strawberries makes it the ideal dessert for parties or big gatherings, offering a refreshing and indulgent taste everyone will love.
